response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only brief C++ exposure in academic or minor roles, and no evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-language adaptability with diverse tech exposure
Proven leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring via workshops
Extensive experience building scalable systems and DevOps infrastructure
concerns: No demonstrable 8+ years of C++ experience as required
Lacks documented experience with cloud compute platforms or distributed systems at scale
No evidence of technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering teams
